Class DiscountFood

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.effects.instant.CardEffectInstant
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.effects.instant.DiscountFood
public class DiscountFood extends CardEffectInstant
An instant effect that applies a cost discount to the owning player.

The exact discount rule is determined by discountFoodType: it may add a flat food discount, grant a per-card-category discount, or reduce building costs. The cat and foodAmount fields carry the parameters needed by the chosen rule.
